# ForgeSuite Studio

> Zero-backend, privacy-first micro-SaaS, DevSecOps, and Web3 security tool portfolio by youthmy11-ai. Offers 7 client-side browser applications (including TokenGuard live EVM & Solana contract risk scanner), 2 open-core desktop/browser tools (AutoShorts Studio and WebLead & Table Extractor), a zero-dependency Node 22+ MCP Server (v1.1.0, 6 tools), and an All-Access Lifetime Pro Bundle ($15–$49 pricing, zero subscriptions, zero server uploads) with instant client-side on-chain BSC USDT (BEP20) and Solana SPL USDC auto-unlock plus TRC20, Binance Pay, and PayPal checkout.

ForgeSuite Studio is designed for solo founders, independent freelancers, AI engineers, content creators, and Web3 builders who want fast local-first software without recurring subscriptions or cloud tracking.

- **Client-Side Privacy Guarantee**: All 7 web applications run 100% in local browser memory with zero ForgeSuite backend servers, zero analytics, and zero data uploads. QR codes are rendered offline via pure ES module JavaScript (`assets/qr.js`), CryptoBill invoices share state via client-only `#inv=` URL fragments, and TokenGuard queries CORS-friendly public JSON-RPC nodes directly from the browser.
- **Transparent Lifetime Pricing**: 7 web utilities provide generous free tiers immediately; Pro lifetime licenses are $15 (CryptoBill Forge Pro), $19 (AutoShorts Studio Pro), $15 (WebLead & Table Extractor Pro), or $35 for the All-Access Bundle (compare at $49, save $14 — also unlocks TokenGuard 25-token Batch Watchlist & JSON/CSV Risk Dossier export).
- **Instant Crypto & PayPal Checkout**: Automatic client-side RPC verification on BNB Smart Chain (`USDT BEP20`) and Solana Mainnet (`SPL USDC`) issues deterministic checksummed offline license keys (`FS-PRO-...`) in seconds. Manual rails (`USDT TRC20`, `Binance Pay`, `PayPal`) are supported via `youthmy11@gmail.com`.

## Live Browser Applications (100% Client-Side)

- [ForgeSuite Studio Hub & Storefront](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/): Catalog of all 10 tools and bundle offerings, interactive CryptoBill QR sandbox, transparent pricing table, and instant on-chain license verifier.
- [CryptoBill Forge](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/cryptobill.html): Free + $15 Pro lifetime serverless crypto & PayPal freelance invoice builder with A4 PDF export, deterministic offline QR codes, and shareable `#inv=` client payment links.
- [TokenGuard Risk Scanner](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/tokenaudit.html): Free unlimited single-token scanner + Pro 25-token Batch Watchlist (`$35` Bundle) auditing live EVM (`Base`, `Ethereum`, `BSC`, `Arbitrum`) bytecode opcodes (`SELFDESTRUCT`, `DELEGATECALL`), EIP-1967/1167 proxies, honeypot tax selectors, and Solana (`SPL` & `Token-2022`) `mintAuthority`, `freezeAuthority`, `permanentDelegate`, `transferFeeConfig`, and holder concentration.
- [TokenCost Lab](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/tokencalc.html): Free ($0) offline LLM token counter and monthly AI agent API budget calculator comparing frontier models (GPT-5, Claude 4.5, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek V3) with 1-click CryptoBill quote export.
- [JSON2Sheet & PII Masker](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/json2sheet.html): Free ($0) offline nested JSON flattener to RFC-4180 CSV, TSV, and GitHub Markdown tables with Excel formula-injection protection and instant email/IP/token PII redaction.
- [ScopeGuard SOW Builder](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/sowbuilder.html): Free ($0) offline freelance, AI engineering, and Web3 audit Statement of Work generator with 100%-balanced milestone splits and 1-click CryptoBill USDT invoicing.
- [Calldata Lens](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/txdecode.html): Free ($0) offline Ethereum & BSC EVM hex calldata decoder for ERC-20 transfers, infinite `MAX_UINT256` approval risk alerts, EIP-2612 permits, ERC-4626 vaults, and Safe multisig payloads.
- [EnvShield Secret Scanner](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/envshield.html): Free ($0) offline `.env`, JSON, and AI transcript secret scanner & redactor detecting OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, AWS, Telegram, JWT, DB URI passwords, EVM private keys, and high-entropy credentials.
- [ForgeSuite MCP Server (v1.1.0)](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/mcp.html): Free ($0) zero-dependency single-file Node 22+ JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio MCP server (`https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/mcp/forgesuite-mcp.mjs`) for Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, and Windsurf exposing 6 tools: `envshield_scan`, `calldata_decode`, `tokencost_estimate`, `cryptobill_quote`, `evm_token_risk_scan`, and `solana_mint_risk_scan`.

## Open-Core Packaged Tools & Lifetime Bundle

- [AutoShorts Studio](https://github.com/youthmy11-ai/autoshorts-studio): Free MIT Community Edition + $19 Pro lifetime Python/FFmpeg desktop GUI & CLI for 9:16/16:9/1:1 batch short-form video assembly, SHA-256 SQLite deduplication, beat-milestone audio trimming, and beat-synced `.srt` subtitles.
- [WebLead & Table Extractor](https://github.com/youthmy11-ai/weblead-extractor): Free MIT Lite Edition + $15 Pro lifetime privacy-first Chrome Manifest V3 extension extracting HTML tables, ARIA grids, Schema.org JSON-LD entities, public emails, and links to RFC-4180 CSV, JSON, and Markdown.
- [All-Access Creator & Freelancer Bundle](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/#pricing): $35 lifetime all-access license key (compare at $49, save $14) unlocking CryptoBill Forge Pro ($15), TokenGuard 25-Token Batch Watchlist & CSV/JSON Dossier export, AutoShorts Studio Pro ($19), and WebLead & Table Extractor Pro ($15).
